3␟Sultan Muhammad: One of the most influential Persian painters of any era, a leading master of the Tabriz school whose full-page miniatures filled the great illustrated manuscripts produced for the Safavid court.
4␟haft rang: A Persian tile technique whose name means "seven colors": several glaze colors were painted onto large tile panels and fired together, instead of cutting and assembling tiny single-color mosaic pieces. Faster to make, and stunning on a building.
